newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Tongkah plans stock issues, unit listing.
newsitem.headline: Tongkah plans stock issues, unit listing.

text.p: Diversified Malaysian firm Tongkah Holdings Bhd said it is planning a two-for-three rights issue and a special issue of new stock, and that it proposes to list shares of a manufacturing subsidiary.

In a statement sent to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) late on Tuesday, Tongkah said the stock issues are related to previously-announced planned purchases of 88 percent in Perdana Finance Bhd and 16.45 percent of Hospital Pantai Bhd .
The rights issue involves up to 142.34 million new Tongkah shares at an issue price of 2.35 ringgit per share on the basis of two new shares for every three existing shares.

Tongkah, whose businesses include an Internet service, hospitals and a seismic data processing firm, said it would also make a special issue of 68 million new ordinary shares to Bumiputera (ethnic Malay) Tongkah directors and other approved investors at 2.35 ringgit a share.
In the proposed stock listing, Tongkah said it seeks to conduct an initial public offering for 50.05 percent-owned subsidiary THB Industries Bhd on the main board of the KLSE.
THB Industries makes carbide precision tools, dies, moulds, jigs and other products.

Gross proceeds from the proposed rights and special stock issues are expected to range from 407.21 million to 494.29 million ringgit depending on the level of exercise of the unexercised warrants and options, the statement said.
The funds would be used to finance the hospital acquisition, increase capital in Tongkah unit Kestrel Securities Sdn Bhd and for a capital injection into Perdana Finance, among other things.
Tongkah's stock requoted on Wednesday after being suspended since October 29. Its shares dipped 20 cents to 4.14 ringgit in morning trading.
